summary: Aims to focus discussion on authentication problems in the Internet and possible solutions. It suggests mediated access-control and authentication procedures for setting up an association between users in different trust environments. The proposals were experimental and not intended as standards.

eli5.summary: When two strangers need to trust each other, a friend that both know can vouch for them. This memo suggests using that kind of middleman for computers.

questions: how to authenticate users across trust domains
what is the distributed-protocol authentication scheme
